successor_of.reason: The approved r4 execution stopped during pre-execution parsing with zero prerequisite, deploy, GET, Cloudflare, or provider invocations and no execution artifacts. r4 contained prose-only required surfaces and is non-executable. Its approval was not used for an operation but is invalid for r5 and must not be reused.

authorization_scope.approval_requirement: A real independent review must accept these exact r5 bytes, then fresh owner approval must name their exact SHA-256. No prior approval authorizes r5.
authorization_scope.authorized_operation: Deploy the exact reviewed source-pinned 2026-02 public-key trust map while preserving inactive production posture, then perform only the retained read-only observations and three smoke GETs.
forbidden: POST requests or strike creation during verification
retry, substitution, replacement, or a second invocation where one is authorized
rollback without a separate reviewed packet and fresh approval
traffic, route, resource, var, secret, or binding mutation outside the single deploy
verification side effects beyond two served-metric writes and two KV projection-repair writes total

process_completion_semantics.scope: Every retained prerequisite, Cloudflare observation, deploy, metadata check, GET, and continuous observation command.
process_completion_semantics.single_invocation_rule: Start each literal command exactly once. A yielded cell/session/process ID remains that same invocation.
process_completion_semantics.continuation_rule: Continue only by wait/poll/resume on the exact yielded ID until exactly one terminal exit status and complete stdout/stderr are retained. Same-ID continuation is not a retry.
process_completion_semantics.accounting_rule: For every command record command_name, literal_command, invocation_count=1, wait_poll_count>=0, started_at, ended_at, terminal_exit, stdout_sha256, and stderr_sha256.
process_completion_semantics.terminal_ambiguity: Lost or inaccessible ID; replacement process; incomplete stdout/stderr; missing or multiple terminal exits; parser input not byte-identical to retained output; or inability to establish the command-specific schema. Stop without retry or substitution.

literal_prerequisites.name: git_source_and_index
literal_prerequisites.command: test "$(git branch --show-current)" = develop && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 0e624016edd15a2308183f3ad0f045da05f5b728 && test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = 0e624016edd15a2308183f3ad0f045da05f5b728 && git merge-base --is-ancestor e97f863912b2fc0cdfa17d58d6a50e4b68898fd5 HEAD && git diff --quiet -- && git diff --cached --quiet --
literal_prerequisites.parser: Require terminal exit 0 and byte length zero for both streams.
literal_prerequisites.terminal_ambiguity: Any output, missing terminal exit, nonzero exit, lost ID, or incomplete streams.

literal_prerequisites.name: exact_19_path_allowlist
literal_prerequisites.parser: Exact byte-string equality after LC_ALL=C sort; require all 19 unique packet-listed paths and no other untracked path.
literal_prerequisites.terminal_ambiguity: Any output, nonzero/missing exit, missing/extra/duplicate path, lost ID, or incomplete streams.

literal_prerequisites.name: all_16_inherited_hashes
literal_prerequisites.output_schema: exactly 16 lines, each '<path>: OK'; stderr empty
literal_prerequisites.parser: Require 16 unique paths, each equal to one inherited_artifact_sha256 key, and every line suffix ': OK'.
literal_prerequisites.terminal_ambiguity: Any missing/extra line, non-OK result, nonzero/missing exit, lost ID, or incomplete streams.

literal_prerequisites.name: pinned_wrangler
literal_prerequisites.output_schema: stdout consumed by test and therefore empty; stderr empty
literal_prerequisites.terminal_ambiguity: Any output, nonzero/missing exit, lost ID, or incomplete streams.

literal_prerequisites.name: offline_repository_gates
literal_prerequisites.command: npm run writer:preflight && npm run assembly:verify && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/oddspark-production-key-pin-check.log npm run check
literal_prerequisites.output_schema: complete npm transcript containing successful writer preflight, assembly identity 0eca7833bf857403949928960f2975116445e593471d5c84c9e47499657318e6, and complete check success; no warning/error line
literal_prerequisites.parser: Require terminal exit 0, exact assembly identity once or more, all three command stages present, and reject case-insensitive lines matching warning, error, fail, provider request, or remote upload except expected test names explicitly marked pass.
literal_prerequisites.terminal_ambiguity: Any stage absent, parser rejection, nonzero/missing exit, lost ID, or incomplete transcript.

literal_prerequisites.name: exact_wrangler_dry_run
literal_prerequisites.output_schema: Wrangler dry-run text; exactly six printed bindings named AI, AI_MODEL, AI_MODEL_FALLBACK, COORD, METER, SPARKS; no upload/version ID; no warning
literal_prerequisites.parser: Extract binding names only from the 'Your Worker has access to the following bindings' block, sort bytewise, require exact equality to binding_invariants.expected_bindings_sorted; reject ACTIVATION_SNAPSHOT, ACTIVATION_MANIFEST, warning, upload, deployed, or Current Version ID.
literal_prerequisites.terminal_ambiguity: Binding block missing/unparseable, mismatch, warning, nonzero/missing exit, lost ID, or incomplete transcript.

workers_builds_conflict_gate.claim_removed: No truthful Wrangler 4.123.0 read-only command or cited Cloudflare read-only API was found that reports pending/running Workers Builds activity. r5 does not claim to observe that activity and does not claim dashboard freshness.
workers_builds_conflict_gate.retained_owner_observation: The pinned inherited r1 packet/handoff/review historically record repository Hearn-Systems-LLC/oddspark.dev, production branch main, production command npx wrangler deploy, non-production command npx wrangler versions upload, root /, and no deploy hooks. Their exact hashes prove only what was retained, not current Cloudflare state.
workers_builds_conflict_gate.strongest_executable_invariant: Run the literal deployment-status snapshot immediately before deploy, then the literal versions inventory immediately before deploy, permit no intervening operation, and invoke the preserved deploy command with --strict. --strict must reject conflicting remote changes.
workers_builds_conflict_gate.unobservable_residual: A pending or running Workers Build that has not yet created a version/deployment is invisible to this packet. A build may begin after the snapshots. If it creates conflicting remote state before upload, --strict is the executable guard; activity not producing such a conflict remains unobservable.

pre_deploy_cloudflare_observations.name: immediate_current_production_deployment
pre_deploy_cloudflare_observations.output_schema: one JSON object with string id, RFC3339 created_on, versions array, and no non-JSON stdout
pre_deploy_cloudflare_observations.parser: jq -e 'type=="object" and (.id|type=="string") and (.created_on|type=="string") and (.versions|type=="array" and length==1) and (.versions[0].version_id=="d7bdc546-04a5-4ee5-bd4a-9406b03c255e") and (.versions[0].percentage==100)'
pre_deploy_cloudflare_observations.terminal_ambiguity: Malformed/additional stdout, absent fields, non-sole version, percentage not numeric 100, different version, or incomplete terminal result.

pre_deploy_cloudflare_observations.name: immediate_versions_inventory
pre_deploy_cloudflare_observations.output_schema: JSON array of at most the 10 most recent deployable versions; each item has string id, metadata.created_on/author_email/source, resources, and optional annotations
pre_deploy_cloudflare_observations.parser: jq -e 'type=="array" and length>0 and length<=10 and all(.[]; (.id|type=="string") and (.metadata.created_on|type=="string") and (.metadata.source|type=="string")) and any(.[]; .id=="d7bdc546-04a5-4ee5-bd4a-9406b03c255e")'; retain canonical jq -S bytes and SHA-256 as the closed pre-deploy inventory
pre_deploy_cloudflare_observations.terminal_ambiguity: Malformed/additional stdout, more than 10 items, missing current production version, duplicate IDs, incomplete result, or any version/deployment observation between this command and deploy not retained as an abort.

deployment.command: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=e72c232411bedeed357f3c73e4f4f0aa WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/oddspark-production-key-pin-2026-02.log npx --no-install wrangler deploy --config /Volumes/fast/Github/oddspark/wrangler.toml --name oddspark --strict --message 'production key pin 2026-02; source 0e624016edd15a2308183f3ad0f045da05f5b728; assembly 0eca7833bf857403949928960f2975116445e593471d5c84c9e47499657318e6'
deployment.output_schema: complete Wrangler deploy transcript with exactly one line 'Current Version ID: <lowercase UUID>' and successful deployed target; no warning/error
deployment.parser: Extract with anchored regex '^Current Version ID: ([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})$'; require exactly one match and call it NEW_VERSION_ID; reject NEW_VERSION_ID=d7bdc546-04a5-4ee5-bd4a-9406b03c255e, warning, error, or any second version ID.
deployment.same_id_polling: Required under process_completion_semantics if yielded; never restart.
deployment.terminal_ambiguity: Version ID absent/duplicate/unparseable, warning/error, nonzero/missing exit, lost ID, or incomplete transcript.

post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.name: sole_100_percent_new_deployment
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.output_schema: one JSON deployment object with exactly one versions element
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.parser: jq --arg id "$NEW_VERSION_ID" -e 'type=="object" and (.id|type=="string") and (.created_on|type=="string") and (.versions|length==1) and (.versions[0].version_id==$id) and (.versions[0].percentage==100)'
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.terminal_ambiguity: NEW_VERSION_ID missing, output non-JSON, split traffic, percentage not numeric 100, different ID, or incomplete terminal result.

post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.name: new_version_metadata_message_and_bindings
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.output_schema: one JSON version object with id, metadata, annotations, and resources.bindings array
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.parser: Require .id==$NEW_VERSION_ID; .metadata.source=="wrangler"; .annotations["workers/message"]=="production key pin 2026-02; source 0e624016edd15a2308183f3ad0f045da05f5b728; assembly 0eca7833bf857403949928960f2975116445e593471d5c84c9e47499657318e6"; derive [ .resources.bindings[].name ] | unique | sort and require exact ["AI","AI_MODEL","AI_MODEL_FALLBACK","COORD","METER","SPARKS"]; require binding array length 6; require no binding name ACTIVATION_MANIFEST or ACTIVATION_SNAPSHOT; require AI_MODEL text equals @cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b and AI_MODEL_FALLBACK text equals @cf/openai/gpt-oss-20b; reject malformed, duplicate, secret, or additional binding.
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.terminal_ambiguity: Any required field absent, unknown binding representation prevents exact extraction, mismatch, additional/duplicate binding, or incomplete terminal result.

post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.name: custom_domain_state
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.output_schema: Cloudflare v4 JSON envelope: success true, errors [], result array, result_info
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.parser: jq -e '.success==true and .errors==[] and (.result|type=="array" and length==1) and (.result[0].hostname=="oddspark.dev") and (.result[0].service=="oddspark") and ((.result[0].environment // "production")=="production") and (.result[0].id|type=="string") and (.result[0].zone_id|type=="string")'
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.credential_rule: Use only an already-authorized ambient CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN with Workers Scripts Read or Write. Never print, hash, retain, inspect, or source the token. Absence is terminal; do not substitute another credential surface.
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.route_scope: wrangler.toml config hash and dry-run prove the intended custom-domain route; this API command proves the current account-level custom domain maps oddspark.dev to oddspark. It does not prove ordinary zone Worker routes absent account-wide.
post_deploy_cloudflare_observations.terminal_ambiguity: Credential absent, non-JSON/additional output, pagination/filter mismatch, zero/multiple result, hostname/service/environment mismatch, or incomplete terminal result.

smoke_gets.name: root_html
smoke_gets.output_schema: stdout exactly '200\ntext/html; charset=utf-8\n'; retained headers and non-empty body
smoke_gets.parser: Require stdout exact; final HTTP header block status exactly 200 and Content-Type media type text/html with charset=utf-8 case-insensitively; body non-empty and contains an HTML doctype or html element plus visible Oddspark marker; reject redirect status/block, duplicate final content-type, or parser ambiguity.
smoke_gets.terminal_ambiguity: Any status/header/body mismatch, redirect ambiguity, nonzero/missing exit, lost ID, or incomplete retained files.

smoke_gets.name: legacy_text_permalink
smoke_gets.output_schema: stdout exactly '200\ntext/plain; charset=utf-8\n'; retained headers and UTF-8 text body
smoke_gets.parser: Require stdout exact and final header status/content-type exact as above; decode body as UTF-8; require non-empty headline, premise, question, provenance rows, and seed formula sections already defined by the retained legacy 632dcc0b contract; retain body SHA-256 for cross-check; any missing/duplicate section is terminal.
smoke_gets.terminal_ambiguity: Any status/header/body/UTF-8/section mismatch, nonzero/missing exit, lost ID, or incomplete retained files.

smoke_gets.name: legacy_json_view
smoke_gets.output_schema: stdout exactly '200\napplication/json; charset=utf-8\n'; retained headers and one JSON object body
smoke_gets.parser: Require stdout exact and final header status/content-type exact; jq -e object parse; require retained artifact identity 632dcc0b at the contract-defined identity field and lossless equality of headline, premise, question, provenance rows, and seed formula to values extracted from /tmp/oddspark-r5-text.body; unknown field names or inability to establish lossless equality is terminal.
smoke_gets.terminal_ambiguity: Any status/header/JSON/cross-view mismatch, nonzero/missing exit, lost ID, or incomplete retained files.

continuous_observation.name: version_bound_300_second_tail
continuous_observation.command_template: set -eu; : "${NEW_VERSION_ID:?missing NEW_VERSION_ID}"; : > /tmp/oddspark-r5-tail.ndjson; : > /tmp/oddspark-r5-tail.stderr; CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=e72c232411bedeed357f3c73e4f4f0aa WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/oddspark-r5-tail-wrangler.log npx --no-install wrangler tail oddspark --config /Volumes/fast/Github/oddspark/wrangler.toml --format json --status ok --status error --status canceled --version-id "$NEW_VERSION_ID" > /tmp/oddspark-r5-tail.ndjson 2> /tmp/oddspark-r5-tail.stderr & tail_pid=$!; trap 'kill -INT "$tail_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' INT TERM HUP; sleep 300; kill -INT "$tail_pid"; set +e; wait "$tail_pid"; tail_rc=$?; set -e; test "$tail_rc" -eq 0 -o "$tail_rc" -eq 130; ! grep -Eqi 'unauthorized|forbidden|failed to create tail|connection.*(closed|failed)' /tmp/oddspark-r5-tail.stderr; jq -c . /tmp/oddspark-r5-tail.ndjson >/dev/null
continuous_observation.output_schema: one continuous 300-second parent process; Wrangler tail remains alive until the commanded interrupt; stderr may be empty but contains no connection/auth failure; stdout file is zero or more newline-delimited JSON objects; every nonblank line independently parses as JSON
continuous_observation.parser: For each NDJSON event require outcome in [ok,error,canceled], exceptions array, logs array, eventTimestamp numeric, and no malformed line. Count outcomes exactly. Require error_count=0, canceled_count=0, and total exception objects=0. Bind comes from Wrangler --version-id NEW_VERSION_ID; retain NEW_VERSION_ID, start/end monotonic timestamps, both files and hashes. Zero events is valid only as 'no invocation observed', never as proof of traffic or provider inactivity.
continuous_observation.same_id_polling: If the outer command yields, continue the exact outer ID. The internal tail PID must never be recreated. The 300-second sleep is one uninterrupted interval; interruption, early tail exit, or missing terminal result is ambiguous.
continuous_observation.terminal_ambiguity: NEW_VERSION_ID missing; tail exits before 300 seconds; kill/wait state unrecognized; malformed NDJSON; connection/auth failure; lost outer ID; recreated tail PID; interrupted window; or incomplete retained files/terminal result.
continuous_observation.honest_contract: This proves only the outcomes/exceptions of invocations observed by a version-filtered real-time tail during the retained interval. Invocation status is not HTTP response status. It cannot support a zero-5xx claim. The three smoke GETs separately prove their exact HTTP statuses and content contracts.
continuous_observation.provider_and_inactive_claim: Absence of ACTIVATION_MANIFEST and ACTIVATION_SNAPSHOT in versions view proves only absence of those activation-authority bindings. Tail has no provider-call identity field. Zero provider calls is therefore not remotely proved by this observation; it remains an authorized side-effect cap and residual risk. Do not infer provider inactivity from zero matching log lines or zero events.

rollback_boundary.failure_rule: A failed post-deploy check never authorizes rollback. Preserve terminal evidence and obtain a separate reviewed rollback packet and fresh approval.

stop_and_abort_conditions: Real independent r5 review absent/non-accepting or fresh approval does not name the exact r5 SHA-256.
Any inherited hash, source hash, Git pin, assembly identity, Wrangler version, exact 19-path allowlist, six-binding invariant, target, command byte, or parser differs.
Any literal command/parser/output schema is missing or cannot be applied mechanically.
Any prerequisite, Cloudflare observation, deploy, GET, metadata check, or continuous observation fails, warns, drifts, or becomes ambiguous.
Any operation occurs between the immediate deployment/version snapshots and deploy, or --strict reports conflicting remote changes.
Any invocation count differs from one; same-ID waits/polls are separately counted and never authorize restart.
Workers Builds activity is asserted as observed despite the declared unobservable residual.
HTTP 5xx absence, provider inactivity, or inactive posture beyond absent activation bindings is inferred from tail.
Any retained side-effect cap would be exceeded or any forbidden operation would occur.
